## Card.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `surface` :: The surface the card is drawn on: `elevated`, `outlined`, `vacant`, `paneled` or `glass`.
- `size` :: The padding and the gap between parts, and the type scale of the parts.
- `shape` :: The corner shape.
- `interactive` :: Makes the whole card a target: it lifts on hover, shows a focus ring and, without `href`, becomes a focusable article that activates on Enter and Space.
- `href` :: Renders the card as an `<a>` that navigates. Implies `interactive`.
- `target` :: Where to open the link, when `href` is set.
- `tilt` :: Tilts the card in 3D toward the pointer. Replaces the hover lift.
- `onclick` :: Called when an interactive card without `href` is activated by click, Enter or Space.
- `children` :: The card's parts and content.

## CardContent.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `textColor` :: The ink of the body text.
- `gap` :: The space between the blocks of body text. @default 'gap-sm'
- `children` :: The card's body.

## CardDescription.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `textColor` :: The ink of the supporting text.
- `children` :: The supporting text.

## CardFooter.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `align` :: Where the footer's items sit along the row.
- `gap` :: The space between the footer's items. @default 'gap-sm'
- `children` :: The footer's actions or metadata.

## CardHeader.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `action` :: A control placed at the trailing edge, such as a menu button or a status tag.
- `gap` :: The space between the title group and the trailing action. @default 'gap-bs'
- `alignContent` :: How the title group and the action sit along the row. @default 'xbetween'
- `children` :: The title and description.

## CardMedia.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `src` :: The image address. Without it the media shows its children, such as an illustration.
- `alt` :: Alternative text for the image. Leave empty for a purely decorative image.
- `ratio` :: Crops the media to an aspect ratio. Without it the image keeps its own.
- `surface` :: The media plate behind and around the image. @default 'paneled'
- `children` :: Content drawn over or instead of the image.

## CardTitle.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `level` :: The heading level, 1 to 6. Pick the one that fits the page outline.
- `children` :: The title text.

## context.ts

### `interface CardContext`

What a card shares with its parts.

- `size` :: The card's size, read lazily so parts follow changes.

### `const setCardContext`

Provide the card's context to its parts.

### `function getCardContext`

The enclosing card's context, or a medium default when a part is used on its own.

### `const gapClass`

The gap between a card's parts at each size.

### `const padToken`

The padding token a card's bleeding media reaches back across, at each size.

### `const titleClass`

Title scale at each size.

### `const bodyClass`

Description and body scale at each size.
